description: The displayed shell-rank formula is a bijection from natural-number pairs to natural numbers and preserves and reflects maximum-first order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank_order_iso :
  Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank ∧
    ∀ (p q : ℕ × ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareLT p q ↔
        Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank p <
          Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank q
